import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
pacific_palisades = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.52, 34.05])

# 50 km west: move ~0.45 degrees west at this latitude
west_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.97, 34.05]).buffer(5000)

# 50 km southwest: move ~0.35 degrees west and ~0.35 degrees south
southwest_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.87, 33.70]).buffer(5000)

date_start = '2025-01-07'
date_end = '2025-01-08'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')

print(f"Total images in collection: {col.size().getInfo()}")

if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No Sentinel-5P data available for 2025-01-07")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Quality masking function
    def mask_no2(image):
        qa = image.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_validity')
        mask = qa.gte(75)
        return image.updateMask(mask)
    
    col_masked = col.map(mask_no2)
    
    # Create composite (mean if multiple overpasses)
    no2_image = col_masked.mean()
    
    # 4. Calculate statistics for both regions
    west_stats = no2_image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=west_point,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    southwest_stats = no2_image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=southwest_point,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    west_mean = west_stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean')
    west_count = west_stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count')
    
    southwest_mean = southwest_stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean')
    southwest_count = southwest_stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count')
    
    print(f"West region: mean={west_mean}, pixels={west_count}")
    print(f"Southwest region: mean={southwest_mean}, pixels={southwest_count}")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if west_count == 0 or southwest_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after quality masking")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif west_mean is None or southwest_mean is None:
        print("Calculation returned None")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif west_mean > 1 or southwest_mean > 1 or west_mean < 0 or southwest_mean < 0:
        print("Invalid NO2 values (out of physical range)")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif west_mean > southwest_mean:
        print(f"West NO2 ({west_mean:.6e}) > Southwest NO2 ({southwest_mean:.6e})")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"West NO2 ({west_mean:.6e}) <= Southwest NO2 ({southwest_mean:.6e})")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
